user.title: Choose your No Hassle AV device

amp.title: Connect your amplifier
amp.description: Enter its serial device or serial-over-IP address. Existing amplifier entries are reused automatically after installation.

matrix.title: Connect your HDMI matrix
matrix.description: For compatible 8×8 models using HTTP video.set and all_dat.get. Setup does not switch outputs. Routes and power are read from the device every 15 seconds. Standby feedback is supported on the tested firmware.

error.unknown: Connection failed. Check the Home Assistant logs.
error.invalid_sources: Give each input a different, non-empty name.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname without http://, a port, or a path.

abort.matrix_options: Matrix settings are fixed at setup in this version. Output names can be changed in the entity settings.

snapshot.name: Save amplifier state
snapshot.description: Save the selected amplifier zone state for later restoration.

restore.name: Restore amplifier state
restore.description: Restore the selected amplifier zone snapshot.
